verdict.rationale: Docs describe plain-language input ('Users can't tell which invoices are overdue') turning into scoped, approvable tasks via 'intentions' that an agent fills in and proposes as tasks, gated by human approval before an agent acts on the repo. This directly matches intent-to-spec workflow with first-party documentation across multiple pages. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the resulting task's scoping quality and no example of the full generated task artifact.
